notes: Zip ordering mirrors the reference (suffix applied before root matching), and squashfs NewObject, List and single-root resolution are consistent with clamped reads; the zip Open past-end special cases and the expectedRemote check in New are somewhat clunky, and tests are comprehensive.

Sound implementation for both backends with good tests, but suffixed single-file roots are not resolved, squashfs New mutates root without reporting a file when --links is off, and it changes zip Open seek-past-EOF behaviour for regular files too.

Basic link translation works, but it silently drops every member under a symlink even without --links, adds a costly per-component ReadDir walk (isUnderSymlink) to squashfs List/NewObject, leaves an unused zip isLink field, does not support suffixed single-file roots, and fails one hidden test.

Clean and close to the reference: zip suffixes before root handling, squashfs newObjectNative prefers a regular member and resolves both root forms, and Open clamps correctly; there is minor struct-field reordering churn, and the squashfs test omits the regular .rclonelink case.

Fixes both zip and squashfs, makes List and NewObject agree, accepts both bare and suffixed single-file roots, and lets a regular .rclonelink member win a name collision; the zip pre-pass duplicates the root logic and the mixed &&/|| rootMatch expression is hard to read, but the tests are thorough (copy, hostile archive, single roots).
